BiblicalUsage: Pequduth is supervision, the charge of a ward. When Jeremiah was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward took him, saying he was falling away to the Chaldeans.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that the prophet's captivity began at a gate: the captain of the ward did his duty, and God used it.
